title: The marketing funnel's start-a-Space links open /create-a-space, carrying ?kit= where a kit is known

source.ref: LIVE-1766 queue PR-1: make the page reachable

detail: Theme Kit pages (theme kit, Designer, Network, Midnight, the Themes index), /for, /pricing and /system sent a visitor to signed-in /spaces/new. They now go to /create-a-space through createSpaceHref (lib/create-space/href.ts), with ?kit=<MegaThemeId> when the kit is one of the seven in PREVIEW_KIT_ORDER. The prototype's own nav and footer carry no Create a Space item (its nav is For people, For spaces, Features, Business Spaces, Pricing, Help; its footer 'Open your Space' goes to /spaces), so the site nav and footer are unchanged. Plan-specific pricing links (?plan=) and the Directory's 'List your business' still go to /spaces/new.
